title: Static-current-KL 262k-to-1M high-pot critic calibration
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Across fresh internal common-deck play against four general anchors and both seats, the 1M endpoints have a replicated high-pot-specific critic calibration degradation relative to their seed-matched 262k parents.
material_change: Zero-Slumbot read-only on-policy critic calibration audit using first decision per pot bucket, matched common-reach hand identities, and a preregistered high-minus-low difference-in-differences gate; no weights or action rules change.
baseline: The 1M scale evaluation had a noisy positive pooled internal slope (+0.4358 bb/100, raw pair CI [-3.0908,3.9625]) but only one of three seeds met breadth. Existing Slumbot attribution localized replicated losses to final pots >=30bb without causal action support.
source: Seed-matched v6-static-current-kl 262k and 1M frozen endpoints, plus Standard10, CFR4, legacy iter16, and legacy mixed65k anchors.
notes: Preflight before record start: py_compile PASS; 3 unit tests PASS; separate 96-hand CPU smoke PASS. Smoke outputs are outside the experiment directory and are not scientific evidence.
All 6,144 generated decks were unique and disjoint from 98,304 prior raw static-current-KL lineage deck digests. Checkpoint SHA256 values were unchanged after evaluation.

The three treatment high-pot residual biases were all optimistic in sign (-9.05,-7.80,-6.02 bb for target minus prediction), but every per-seed 95% CI included zero. This descriptive pooled tendency does not satisfy the preregistered multi-seed significance gate.

result.summary: The fresh 24,576-hand internal calibration audit completed with 590 common-reach high-pot identities. The 1M endpoints did not have higher high-pot error than their 262k parents: pooled squared-error delta was -223.94 bb^2 with CI95 [-531.66,83.78], and high-minus-low difference-in-differences was -103.50 with CI95 [-252.44,45.44].
result.conclusion: The externally localized >=30bb loss class does not close a causal loop through worsening internal critic calibration. Error worsening appeared in only one seed, high-pot specificity pointed negative, and no treatment seed had a significant residual bias. Do not oversample high-pot states, reset the critic, reverse actions, or imitate solver/Slumbot labels from this evidence.
result.next_step: Return to geometric scale evidence for the preserved static-current-KL method. Its 262k-to-1M internal slope was positive in two of three seeds with low drift and no replicated mechanism failure; preregister a multi-seed 1M-to-4M continuation with intermediate 2M checkpoints and untouched broad internal evaluation, rather than opening a benchmark-specific patch.
